description: Theming foundation: convert the app from hardcoded dark-only hex classes to a CSS-variable token system with light (:root) and dark (.dark) palettes, add the dark @custom-variant, make index.css base/scrollbar + index.html body theme-aware, add an anti-flash inline script that applies .dark before paint (default dark, honoring localStorage 'theme' then prefers-color-scheme), and add a shared useTheme hook. This leaves the app visually identical in dark mode and fully buildable; it is the prerequisite for the toggle in FEAT-002. Independent of FEAT-002's UI but must land first.
steps: Create src/hooks/useTheme.ts. Export a pure helper resolveInitialTheme(stored: string | null, prefersDark: boolean): 'dark' | 'light' (stored 'light'|'dark' wins; else prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light'). Export useTheme() returning { theme, toggleTheme }: initial state from document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') (set by the anti-flash script); toggleTheme flips the 'dark' class on document.documentElement, updates React state, and writes localStorage.setItem('theme', next). No new deps.

In src/index.css: after `@import "tailwindcss";` add `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));`. Add a `:root { ... }` block defining all 26 color tokens as --c-<hex> with WCAG-AA-legible LIGHT values (backgrounds->light, text inks->dark, accents shifted to AA on light), plus --c-3f3f46. Add a `.dark { ... }` block defining the SAME tokens with the ORIGINAL dark hex values verbatim (e.g. --c-09090b:#09090b). Change @layer base html,body to background-color:var(--c-09090b); color:var(--c-fafafa);. Change the three ::-webkit-scrollbar rules to use var(--c-09090b) (track), var(--c-27272a) (thumb), var(--c-3f3f46) (thumb hover). Leave the existing @theme named tokens unchanged.

In index.html: add an inline <script> in <head> BEFORE the stylesheet <link>s that reads localStorage.getItem('theme'); if absent, uses window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches; defaults to dark; and adds/removes 'dark' on document.documentElement accordingly (inline the same rule as resolveInitialTheme). Remove the static class="dark" from the <html> tag (the script now owns it). Replace the <body> arbitrary hex classes with var equivalents: bg-[var(--c-09090b)] text-[var(--c-fafafa)] antialiased selection:bg-[var(--c-7c3aed)] selection:text-[var(--c-ede9fe)].

Mechanically remap every arbitrary-value hex class across the 12 TSX files by replacing the literal `[#<hex>` with `[var(--c-<hex>)` for all 26 colors. Files: src/App.tsx, src/components/Header.tsx, Footer.tsx, Toast.tsx, ScannerView.tsx, StrategyEngineView.tsx, NewsCatalystView.tsx, GovernanceAuditView.tsx, GuardrailsModal.tsx, FactorWeightsModal.tsx, CitationModal.tsx, AuditCertificateModal.tsx. Opacity-modifier forms like [#070709]/90 become [var(--c-070709)]/90. Review the diff; do not alter class structure, only the color token. (A `sed -i '' 's/\[#<hex>/[var(--c-<hex>)/g'` loop over the file list is acceptable, then verify.)
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rE '\[#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}' src --include='*.tsx'` returns no matches (every bracketed hex is now a var token).
index.html has no `class="dark"` on <html> and contains the inline anti-flash script in <head>; <body> uses var-based classes.
src/index.css contains `@custom-variant dark`, a :root light palette, and a .dark dark palette covering all tokens used.
src/hooks/useTheme.ts exports useTheme and resolveInitialTheme and type-checks.
npm run lint is clean and npm run build succeeds; existing npm run test (src/api suites) still passes.
verification: npm run build  (vite build succeeds; dist produced)
npm run test  (vitest run; all existing src/api tests pass)
findings:
Done. Theming foundation landed; dark mode is visually identical (verbatim original hex in .dark). For FEAT-002:
- Hook file: src/hooks/useTheme.ts. Import as: import { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme'; (Header is in src/components, so '../hooks/useTheme'; App.tsx would use './hooks/useTheme').
- Signatures: `export function useTheme(): { theme: 'dark' | 'light'; toggleTheme: () => void }` and `export function resolveInitialTheme(stored: string | null, prefersDark: boolean): 'dark' | 'light'`. Also exported type alias `Theme = 'dark' | 'light'`.
- useTheme() reads initial state from document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') (set pre-paint by the inline script in index.html). toggleTheme flips the 'dark' class on <html>, updates React state, and persists localStorage.setItem('theme', next). No new deps.
- Toggle placement (per context.json): Header right-side cluster near the profile menu. lucide-react is installed; import { Sun, Moon } from 'lucide-react'. Header does NOT yet import useTheme or lucide icons — FEAT-002 adds them.
- Token naming: CSS variables are named --c-<original-dark-hex>, referenced in TSX/HTML as arbitrary classes e.g. text-[var(--c-fafafa)], bg-[var(--c-09090b)]/90 (opacity modifiers work). Palettes defined in src/index.css: :root (light) and .dark (dark). 27 tokens total (26 TSX colors + --c-3f3f46 scrollbar-only). @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)) is defined if dark: variants are needed.
- Default theme is dark (anti-flash script + no explicit light default). All verification clean: npm run lint, npm run build, npm run test (61 pass), grep returns no bracketed hex.
